name: Wi-Fi Trainer Bridge
description: Drives a Wi-Fi Wahoo Kickr from Biketerra over the WFTNP protocol: feeds the trainer's real power & cadence into the game, and relays resistance control (erg / sim) to the Kickr. Host & port are configurable.

settings.label: Kickr IP address
settings.description: The Wi-Fi IP address of the Kickr (shown in the Wahoo Fitness app, or via `avahi-browse _wahoo-fitness-tnp._tcp` on the same network).

settings.label: WFTNP port
settings.description: Kickr Wi-Fi (WFTNP) TCP port. Wahoo's spec default is 36866; recent Kickr Wi-Fi units are commonly observed on 36867. If the bridge can't connect, try the other value.
